summary: Iteration 122: Tactical RMM (TRMM) Integration Backend Testing - All 25 tests PASSED. Verified all TRMM endpoints return well-shaped responses when not configured (configured=false, success=false with messages), settings CRUD works correctly, device↔agent linking persists/unsets trmm_agent_id, and regression smoke tests confirm existing integrations (health, auth, UniFi, CIPP, Hudu) still work.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/trmm/status: Returns expected shape with configured=false, base_url='', api_key_preview=null, verify_tls=true, last_test_status=null, last_tested_at=null, last_synced_at=null when not configured

GET /api/trmm/summary: Returns configured=false with stats object containing all zero values (agents=0, online=0, offline=0, alerts=0, checks_failing=0, patches_pending=0, needs_reboot=0) when not configured
GET /api/trmm/test: Returns success=false with message='Not configured' when no credentials - correct graceful handling
POST /api/trmm/settings: Saves base_url, api_key, verify_tls correctly. api_key_preview shows last 4 chars (e.g., '…5678'). Returns 400 for missing/empty base_url or api_key
GET /api/trmm/status after save: Shows configured=true, correct base_url, api_key_preview, and verify_tls flag
GET /api/trmm/test with unreachable URL: Returns success=false with useful error message (TRMM request failed: ...) - does NOT raise 500
DELETE /api/trmm/settings: Removes credentials, status becomes configured=false again
GET /api/trmm/actions/log: Returns empty array [] when no actions logged
GET /api/trmm/linked-devices: Returns empty array [] when no devices linked
POST /api/devices/{id}/link-trmm-agent: Persists trmm_agent_id and trmm_hostname on device record. Returns 400 for missing agent_id, 404 for non-existent device
DELETE /api/devices/{id}/link-trmm-agent: Unsets trmm_agent_id, trmm_hostname, trmm_linked_at from device
All TRMM endpoints require authentication (return 401/403 without token)
seed_data_creation: Used existing devices from /api/devices for link/unlink tests. Created and cleaned up TEST_TRMM_AGENT_122 link on first available device.
